test: Isoform Control: ENC-001 Encoding Null Model
method: Re-ran ENC-001 encoding null model (vocabulary hit rate: real vs shuffled sequences) using canonical-only proteins (1 per gene from canonical_gene_uniprot, n=20246) vs all isoforms (n=78007). Each condition sampled 1000 proteins.
conclusion: Canonical-only analysis (1000 proteins from 20246 genes) yields t=7.96 (p=3.34e-15) vs all-isoform t=5.58 (p=2.80e-08). Hit ratio: 1.784x vs 1.696x. Both are highly significant. Isoform inflation does not explain the encoding signal.
